item.title: Pom in Oz with Derek Goforth: Delayed flight chaos was an expensive, but priceless, lesson in silver linings
item.description: There is a moment in every holiday where something goes wrong. Not mildly wrong. Properly wrong.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 13: Women and lower divisions get their say as men take general bye
item.description: With a bye in the men’s first division, round 13 of the Geraldton softball season will shift the spotlight onto the women and the lower divisions, giving other teams the chance to claim headlines this weekend.

item.title: Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association round 13: Chapman Valley claim shock win, Stateside roll Hawks
item.description: A huge upset rocked the Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association’s men’s division, as Chapman Valley took out a thrilling two point win over provisional minor premiers Pumas in round 13.

item.title: Geraldton caught in a spin, as captains reflect on disappointing country week cricket campaigns
item.description: Geraldton captains Kade Gillingham and Olivia Bidwell believe limited exposure to spin played a role in their batting woes, as both captains reflect on country week campaigns that went off script.

item.title: Australia Day in Geraldton: Fireworks wrap up full day of celebrations as community reflects on national day
item.description: Australia’s national day drew a crowd in the thousands to Geraldton’s foreshore on Monday for a full day and night of celebrating what it means to be Australian.

item.title: Fishing e-petition on track for record number of signatures, as Geraldton prepares to host fishing forum
item.description: WA fishers have made their stance loud and clear, as a petition calling for a parliamentary inquiry is on track to becoming the most signed e-petition in the history of WA’s legislative council.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: Geraldton City Band reminds me how much talent we have in our own backyard
item.description: What did you do on Australia Day? One event I went to as a city councillor really grabbed my interest and made my jaw drop.

item.title: Geraldton’s Sundays by the Sea returns for 10th year with two acts performing each session for the first time
item.description: A popular way to while away your Sunday afternoons is back for its 10th anniversary — and it’s providing a double dose of entertainment.

item.title: Good for You: Spacey Jane receives equal most entries in 2025 Triple J Hottest 100 count for a second time
item.description: WA rock band Spacey Jane — with their distinct Geraldton flavour — have again enjoyed another successful run in triple j’s Hottest 100 — again prominent, but still chasing an elusive No. 1 victory.

item.title: Geraldton’s local organisations support families to send students back to school with dignity
item.description: As families prepare for the new school year, several community groups in Geraldton are rallying around families to support them through this difficult time.
